snippet.title: Trick2G
snippet.description:
Welcome! This is Trick2G's Youtube, I post highlight videos as well as educational videos on how to play the game known as "My Ways".

***       Please make sure to to turn on notifications so you do not miss a single upload!       ***
I love theory crafting and trying crazy builds for you guys and having fun while engaging as much as possible with my audience. 

Follow me!
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/trick2g
Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/trick2g
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/trick2g

Join my discord for exclusive updates and giveaways: discord.gg/trick2g

For permissions to use any of my content please email me here: trick2g@trick2g.org
